summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing preliminary Q1 2026 operating results and April 30, 2026 share count. Items 2.02 and 8.01 cover selected financials: $185.5M cash, 15.5M shares outstanding, Q1 net cash used $40.2M, net loss $40.8M, product revenue $6.9M (including $3.7M from TONMYA launched Nov 2025). The filing is a routine preliminary earnings disclosure with no M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic event. No special-situation catalysts or structural changes are present. The 8-K is purely informational, providing guidance on cash runway into Q2 2027, and does not trigger a special situation classification.
